To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Patent Agent recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIT Madras Patent Agent recruitment is 29th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Patent Agent post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Registered Indian Patent Agent and possess a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemistry with strong domain expertise.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, 0-5 years of experience in conducting patentability searches in chemistry/Organic Chemistry related inventions is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Patent Agent position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 25,000/- upwards per month, based on the candidate's experience.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Patent Agent post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Patent Agent post at IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Online.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Patent Agent role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting, followed by a test/interview, and document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification link is provided in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IIT Madras for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for this recruitment is https://icandsr.iitm.ac.in.
